name: 01_headline
headline:
Largest gain in the state.
In *both* subjects.
body: The state scores every district 0 to 100 in each subject. Andover's English index rose 6.1 points and its math index 6.8. Both are the largest one-year gains of any town district in the state.

name: 02_proficiency
headline: Andover, against the state.
caption: About 110 Andover students in grades 3 through 6 sat these tests in spring 2026.

name: 03_growth
kicker: THE MEASURE THAT ASKS HOW FAR THEY MOVED
headline: Growth, not just starting point.

hero.subtitle: average share of each student's growth target met

body: Every student gets a target based on their own prior score, whether they are behind or already ahead. This measure asks how far each child actually moved, which makes it much less a reflection of who a district teaches.

name: 05_not_demographics
headline: Did the students change?

rows.label: the raw gain, combined across subjects
still there after adjusting for student need

emphasis: Most of the gain is not explained by demographics.
source: CT EdSight, Performance Index; adjustment across all 164 town districts

name: 06_one_good_year
quote: It is not a one-shot deal. We can't just say we had one good year.
